### Hello! 👋

:::{.column-margin}
![Photo taken by Wei Sun.](profile_2.jpg)

:::

I am a Ph.D. candidate at [Northwestern University](https://www.northwestern/edu/), fortunate to be advised by Professor [Matthew Kay](https://www.mjskay.com/).

Before joining Northwestern, I was a student at [William & Mary](https://www.wm.edu/), where I majored in Computer Science and Economics.

## Research 

I am interested in developing both theoretical frameworks and practical tools for the robust evaluation of information visualization. I had also worked on questions that involve more economics and fairness concerns previously.

My CV (last updated Oct 2024) is [here](grad_cv.pdf).
